decisions.title: Go-live date and release strategy
decisions.answer: C: staged, with a go/no-go on 28 Oct 2026. G3 green on staging by 28 Oct means 4 Nov training runs on the new platform; otherwise training and January run on baseline/pre-remediation plus critical fixes and the programme continues for the next event (owner, 2026-09-26)

decisions.title: Reuse model (tenancy)
decisions.answer: A: many events in one deployment, one organisation (SP SoC), with an Organisation row as the schema root (owner, 2026-09-25)

decisions.title: How flexible roles are
decisions.answer: A: fixed role catalogue (Volunteer, IC, Deputy, Chief, Lead, Admin), renameable per event; admins edit each role's permitted actions per event; guardrail policies locked (owner, 2026-09-26)

decisions.title: Product invariants
decisions.answer: Configurable per event: 'the three counts never merge' and 'no visitor personal data' become per-event options, not fixed invariants (owner, 2026-09-25)

decisions.title: Which branch is the baseline
decisions.answer: Stay on the current working branch. Do NOT fast-forward to origin/feat/audit-cloudwatch; its 5 commits (CloudWatch audit, audit-log/roster-import screens, Lightsail infra, smoke test) stay out of the baseline. (owner, 2026-09-25)

decisions.title: How Verified Permissions is evaluated
decisions.answer: A (design, ADR-005 §6): AVP IsAuthorized authoritative behind a 30 s bus-invalidated decision cache; degraded local Cedar for Capture/Self/Safety, fail closed for Correct/Manage/Configure/Platform; UI affordances evaluated locally (BatchIsAuthorized USD 150/M). Proposed until G1.

decisions.title: Compute and hosting
decisions.answer: ADR-008 lean topology (owner, G1 2026-09-26): API Gateway HTTP API + Cloud Map, one Fargate ARM service serving the API and a static-export client; RDS Postgres 17 db.t4g.micro single-AZ, resized for event days; no NAT, no interface endpoints; staging parked when idle

decisions.title: Domain and email
decisions.answer: Owner 2026-09-30: Firebase Hosting (*.web.app) client, DuckDNS HTTPS API, no Route 53/ACM/SES; SNS email, AWS Budgets, Cognito default invite sender; sessions cannot depend on a third-party refresh cookie. Owner 2026-10-01 approved Singapore Lightsail Micro Caddy proxy at US$7/month with 2 TB included and US$0.12/GB excess outbound transfer. Production stack still waits for 28 October go decision.

decisions.title: Scheduler engine
decisions.answer: A: Postgres job table (design, ADR-004 §4): ScheduledAction with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED claims, leases, retries, dead-letter, transactional handlers. Proposed until G1.

decisions.title: AWS budget and environments
decisions.answer: US$100/month covers staging + production together; no ephemeral dev stack (owner, 2026-09-26, confirmed at G1). Q-P9: about US$130 allowed for January 2027 only, for Cognito Plus, RDS Multi-AZ for event week and WAF (ADR-008 §6); US$100 applies to every other month

decisions.title: Branch and review workflow
decisions.answer: Amended by the owner (2026-09-25): work directly on main. No feature branches, no pull requests, no tags. Commit each step to main and push to main. (Originally A: one PR per phase; PR #1 carried the plan and P00 and was merged.)

decisions.title: Existing data
decisions.answer: Migrate the existing data into SPOH 2027 as Event #1 (owner, G1 2026-09-26; ADR-001, ADR-009)

decisions.title: Access for testing
decisions.answer: Amended (owner, G1 2026-09-26): the agent may use the AWS CLI and this environment's AWS credentials; creating billable resources stays within ADR-008's cost plan; nothing on the live Lightsail site is changed without the owner. Unchanged from 2026-09-25: P00.9 may run the smoke test against staging

decisions.title: Shared state for rate limits and caches
decisions.answer: A: Postgres (design, ADR-003 §3-4): LISTEN/NOTIFY cache bus and an UNLOGGED rate-limit counter table; ElastiCache and DynamoDB rejected on cost and moving parts. Proposed until G1.
